Text paints with an effectively transparent fill (-webkit-text-fill-color / color), so its glyphs are invisible.
findings.fixHint: Set an explicit, opaque `color` on the text — and an explicit `-webkit-text-fill-color` if an ancestor makes the fill transparent. If the transparency is intentional gradient text, add `background-clip: text`.

findings.message: Two text blocks overlap and may render unreadable.
findings.fixHint: Give each block its own zone, or put data-layout-allow-overlap on the text or on a container inside the scene. A marker on the scene root does not apply. Decoration nobody needs to read can take data-layout-ignore.
